# TextArea

Text area — free text over several lines, on `_Field`. The field is 80 high at least, and `rows` grows it from there. With `maxLength`, the caption counts characters on the right. With `appearance="subtle"`, it reads as plain text until hovered or edited, shows Save and Cancel while editing, and stays open when it loses focus.

**Import:** `import { TextArea } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/TextArea/TextArea.jsx`
